llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and requirements are consistent with a Consul service-deregister tool and do not request unrelated credentials or install arbitrary software.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the included script (scripts/deregister.py) and SKILL.md. The skill only requires agent addresses, service IDs, or pasted curl commands to operate — all consistent with a Consul deregister tool.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs running the bundled Python script, passing service IDs, agent lists, or curl text; it may read a user-supplied agents file and optionally accept an ACL token. The instructions do not ask the agent to read unrelated files, environment variables, or external endpoints beyond the user-provided Consul agent URLs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is present (instruction-only with a bundled script). Nothing is downloaded or extracted during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables or credentials are declared. The script accepts an optional --token argument for Consul ACL tokens, which is appropriate and proportional to the stated purpose.

dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable. The skill can perform destructive network actions (deregister) when invoked; platform-default autonomous invocation is allowed, so consider that an agent could trigger deregisters if given permission — this is a behavioral risk rather than an incoherence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do exactly what it says: send Consul /v1/agent/service/deregister PUT requests to agents you specify. Before installing/use: (1) review the script if you want to be certain of behavior (it's included and small); (2) run with --dry-run first to see which requests would be sent; (3) be careful when pasting curl commands or agents files — those inputs determine the targets; (4) only supply ACL tokens you trust and avoid storing them in public places; and (5) consider limiting autonomous agent permissions or requiring explicit user confirmation because the skill performs destructive actions (deregister) against provided hosts.
